title: SOCIAL-003 Like Relationship Contract
invariants: One effective like per actor/resource pair.
Actor identity is derived from the trusted server principal.
Resource visibility/interactability and block/mute policy must be admitted before mutation.
Unlike is an atomic delete and missing relation is idempotent success.
Counters are projections and never determine mutation success.
No synchronous fan-out is required on the authoritative write path.
